leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the ngClass directive to conditionally set CSS classes based on component state.
Construct a component property to control the boolean condition for class application.
Bind an HTML element's class to a component method that returns a class string dynamically.
Configure ngClass with an object syntax to toggle multiple classes based on different conditions.
Integrate user interactions, such as button clicks, to manipulate the conditional class state.
Initialize a component with default state values that determine the initial class rendering.
